info.name: Tamagotchi
info.description:
Every endpoint of the Tamagotchi service, in an order that runs start to finish. Requests capture ids into collection variables, so a full run needs no manual input beyond the Tamagotchi Go Local environment.

UUID v7 is generated in the collection pre-request script because Postman's {{$guid}} is v4 and the contract rejects it.
